Feature: Motorcycle insurance eligibility

  @happy-path
  Scenario: Young rider gets a motorcycle quote
    Given a rider aged 25
    When the rider requests a quote for a "motorcycle"
    Then the quote is accepted with a premium of 480.50

  @error-case
  Scenario: Under-age rider is refused
    Given a rider aged 21
    When the rider requests a quote for a "motorcycle"
    Then the quote is refused with reason "MINIMUM_AGE"
